description: The run history browser -- the whole reason runs are persisted rather than being throwaway snapshots.
signature: def render_past_analyses_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, settings: Settings) -> None
docstring:
Render the list of past and current runs.

Args:
    conn: This page's own short-lived connection.
    settings: For settings.db_path, passed to any button action that needs orchestration (which takes a Path, never a connection).

Behavior:
    - runs_df = storage.list_runs(conn, limit=50) (the module spec's open question about pagination vs a 50-cap is resolved here as a fixed 50-row cap for v1 -- simplest option, revisit only if it proves insufficient in practice).
    - Table columns: run_id, started_at, status, per-stage completion (from a join against run_stages, e.g. '2/3 succeeded'), headline metrics (candidate_count, simple_subset_size where available), duration.
    - Per row: Open button (sets st.query_params['run_id'] = that row's run_id and switches to the Analysis Detail page); Resume button, rendered ONLY when status != 'succeeded' AND run_id not in orchestration.active_run_ids() -- calls orchestration.resume_run(settings.db_path, run_id, settings=settings) and then behaves like a fresh Start (sets the three SESSION_KEYS and shows the progress panel); Delete button behind a two-step confirmation (storage.delete_run cascades irreversibly, per the module's own edge case), calling storage.delete_run(conn, run_id) only after the second explicit confirmation click.
postconditions: Resume is never rendered for a run with status == 'succeeded'
Resume is never rendered for a run currently in orchestration.active_run_ids()
Delete never executes on a single click -- a second, explicit confirmation is always required first

edge_cases.input: orchestration.resume_run raises PipelineError (e.g. another tab resumed it a moment earlier)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: rendered as an inline warning on this page, not an uncaught exception, per the ui module spec's own edge case
only the most recent 50 are shown; no pagination control in v1

edge_cases.input: Delete confirmed on a run that has a live worker (should not normally be possible since Resume/Delete visibility rules should prevent reaching this state, but defensively)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: storage.delete_run does not itself check for a live worker; the UI is responsible for not offering Delete for an active run_id, mirroring the Resume-visibility rule

edge_cases.input: The table is opened immediately after reconcile_orphaned_runs marked several runs failed at startup
edge_cases.expected_behavior: those runs show status='failed' with Resume available, exactly as if they had failed for any other reason -- no special-cased 'orphaned' status or styling

unit_tests.name: test_resume_hidden_for_succeeded_run
unit_tests.description: A row with status='succeeded' shows no Resume button.

unit_tests.name: test_resume_hidden_for_active_run
unit_tests.description: A row whose run_id is in active_run_ids() shows no Resume button even though status='running'.

unit_tests.name: test_resume_shown_for_failed_inactive_run
unit_tests.description: A row with status='failed' and not in active_run_ids() shows Resume.

unit_tests.name: test_delete_requires_two_clicks
unit_tests.description: A single Delete click does not call storage.delete_run; a second confirming click does.
unit_tests.expected: delete_run called 0 times after first click, 1 time after confirmation

unit_tests.name: test_open_sets_query_param_and_switches_page
unit_tests.description: Clicking Open for a row sets st.query_params['run_id'] to that row's run_id.

unit_tests.name: test_resume_failure_shown_inline
unit_tests.description: A stubbed resume_run raising PipelineError results in an inline warning, no uncaught exception.

unit_tests.name: test_limited_to_fifty_rows
unit_tests.description: With 75 fixture runs, exactly 50 most-recent rows are rendered.
